metadata.title: Knowledge Decommissioning

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for safely retiring, removing, and preventing reuse of knowledge retained or derived by AI systems.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: AI model artifacts, embeddings, memory stores, fine-tuned derivatives, caches, and downstream AI dependencies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how AI-retained knowledge and derived artifacts are identified, removed, and rendered unusable at end-of-life.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-specific threat context for residual knowledge leakage, unintended reuse, and post-retirement exposure.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where AI systems retain or expose sensitive knowledge after models or datasets are decommissioned.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where retired AI models continue influencing behavior through embeddings, derivatives, or dependent systems.

metadata.remarks: Knowledge Decommissioning defines how AI systems safely forget. This pattern exists to address AI-native risks where sensitive, outdated, or disallowed knowledge persists beyond model retirement through embeddings, derivatives, caches, or downstream dependencies.

components.title: Residual Artifact Identification
components.description: Identification of embeddings, checkpoints, caches, and other artifacts that retain model knowledge.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI systems maintain inventories of residual artifacts that may retain knowledge after model or data decommissioning.

components.title: Knowledge Retirement
components.description: Secure removal, invalidation, or isolation of AI-retained knowledge and representations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Residual AI knowledge is removed, invalidated, or cryptographically rendered unusable when no longer permitted.

components.title: Downstream Dependency Cleanup
components.description: Identification and remediation of systems or models that depend on retired AI knowledge.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Dependent systems are updated, retrained, or disabled to prevent continued use of retired AI knowledge.
